# Release Gate Checklist: Backend Auth Verification & Super Admin Governance

**Purpose**: Reviewer release-gate requirements-quality validation for ENGR-003 (backend auth lifecycle, dynamic DB-driven permissions, Super Admin governance, and latency verification)  
**Created**: 2026-11-21  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK006 Are immediate in-session permission propagation and immediate access-cutoff requirements fully specified for role/permission revocations and governance-critical account-state changes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-018, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK007 Are church/sub-church governance requirements complete for create/read/view/update/delete/lifecycle operations and explicit per-scope permission assignment? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK008 Are baptised/non-baptised member workflow requirements complete for filtering, status transitions, mutations, and unauthorized transition prevention? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK009 Are announcement governance requirements complete for create/read/view/update/delete and church/sub-church visibility scoping? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK010 Are roles/permissions/settings governance requirements complete for matrix editing, role lock/protection controls, runtime propagation, and auditability? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024, Spec §FR-029, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK011 Are Super Admin profile and security-control requirements complete for personal info updates, password changes, session/token invalidation, and permission/policy checks? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK014 Is "standardized error contract" unambiguously defined with required field names/semantics so `400/401/403/429` responses are consistently interpretable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "immediate in-session" propagation/cutoff quantified with an observable verification boundary (e.g., next affected request/action/UI operation) to avoid ambiguous timing interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the "canonical/seeded Root Super Admin" identity clearly defined with identifying attributes/rules that distinguish it from secondary Super Admins? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK017 Are "step-up password confirmation" requirements sufficiently specific about when confirmation is required, what constitutes successful confirmation, and failure/expiry behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Is "explicit per scope" for sub-church permissions clearly defined for all parent/sub-church operations, including denied cross-scope access expectations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are "active DB state" and "canonical seed baseline" boundaries clearly defined, including what data is captured in the one-time snapshot and how reviewed seed/migration updates evolve it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Are latency budget scopes and measurement conditions clearly defined (environment baseline, p95 vs absolute threshold, included/excluded dependencies, sample/window)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033, Spec §FR-034, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK021 Is "safe denial behavior" for unauthorized frontend routes/actions defined with observable user-facing outcomes aligned to `401`/`403` semantics? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032, Spec §User Story 3]
